verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents batch retrieval of custom object records and multi-object imports that add or update records and create associations in bulk. The evidence never shows batch create, update or delete endpoints, or bulk operations through the MCP server, so the programmatic bulk-write story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented batch write/update/delete API endpoints, bulk actions via MCP or agents, bulk edit/delete of selected records, documented batch limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
